Honestly, I find this game amusing. It's funny to imagine what goes on in a child's mind of what sex is when parent's don't teach them what it even means. It may not be a typical type of game that people would like, but I did find it to be an diversion from my other more serious games. (Shush! Clicker Heroes deserves the UTMOST concentration!) 

But in all seriousness, I liked it and I'm glad that people can take on a roles in the creative process of different creations in this medium. There's no real reason to complain about this title, it didn't cost you money, maybe only five minutes of gameplay, but really, just playing 5 minutes to say it's not worth it seems petty. If you didn't like it in the first minute that you played it, all you had to do was uninstall. 

I hope to see what other creations this little team comes up with! Looking forward to it in the future!
